title: dryopteris filix-mas var. fibrillosa
intro: Dryopteris filix-mas var. fibrillosa, commonly known as the stiff-leaved male fern, is a variety of the male fern plant species that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. It is a type of fern that has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in the treatment of various health conditions. The health benefits of Dryopteris filix-mas var. fibrillosa include its ability to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties, as well as its use in treating skin conditions and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
